data.name: Ekaatmaa
data.gender_notes: Ekaatmaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ekaatmaa refers to a being with a single, undivided soul or mind. This term is often used in Hinduism to describe enlightened beings, who have transcended the dualities of the physical world and achieved a state of unity and oneness with the divine. The name Ekaatmaa carries the meaning “One-Souled, One-Minded” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekaatmaa usually hope their child will grow to embody one-souled, one-minded and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner unity and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Ekaatmaa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One-Souled, One-Minded.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ekaatmaa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ekaatmaa carries deep cultural significance in Hinduism, as it reflects the ultimate spiritual goal of attaining a state of oneness with the Divine. This concept is central to many Hindu philosophies, including Advaita Vedanta and Yoga, which emphasize the union of the individual self with the ultimate reality, or Brahman. The name Ekaatmaa thus symbolizes the highest attainment of spiritual and philosophical knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ekaatmaa holds deep meaning as it signifies the realization of the ultimate truth - that the individual self and the divine are one. This realization is often referred to as "Self-Realization" or "Enlightenment." The name Ekaatmaa also highlights the importance of living a life free from the dualities of the physical world, such as desire and attachment, and instead focusing on the pursuit of inner peace and oneness with the divine. Thus, the name Ekaatmaa is not just a name, but a reminder of the ultimate spiritual goal and the path to achieve it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ekaatmaa signifies one-pointed consciousness, a soul fully immersed and focused in the Divine. It embodies the deep inner longing for spiritual unity and self-realization.

historical_references.reference: The sage Ekaatmaa is mentioned as one of the seven sages in the ancient Indian text, 'Bharata Shastra'. This text is believed to have been composed between 200 BC and 200 AD. Ekaatmaa is said to have been an enlightened sage who attained self-realization and lived an ascetic life.

Another reference to the sage Ekaatmaa can be found in the 'Mahabharata', an epic poem of ancient India. The time of the Mahabharata war is believed to have occurred around 3000 BC. Ekaatmaa is mentioned as a sage who had the divine power to grant a boon to those who remembered him in their thoughts.
